summary.en: A minimal example .io game demonstrating server-authoritative logic, client interpolation and other multiplayer essentials.
summary.zh: 多人 io 游戏的极简示范工程，含服务端权威判定、客户端插值等核心套路。

description.en: The sample itself is a small multiplayer arena: roam with WASD, shoot with the mouse, and score points by taking out other players.
description.zh: 示例本身是一个多人移动的射击小游戏：WASD 移动、鼠标射击，击杀其他玩家得分。

howto.en: WASD to move, mouse to aim and shoot.

tip.en: Not a finished game but a skeleton that shows how .io games are built. When your site outgrows single-player, starting from this beats reinventing the wheel.
tip.zh: 不是成品游戏，是「怎么做 io 游戏」的骨架。如果你的站想从单机升级到联机，从它开始比从零造轮子快得多。
